verdict.rationale: Synthesia's own avatar system creates a reusable persistent character, such as an avatar of yourself from a single photo or stylized 3D, anime and claymation avatars. Outfits, backgrounds and brand assets can also be reused, which implies the same character carries across scenes and videos. The evidence never says outright that a character or scene stays visually consistent across separately generated shots. It is also unclear whether this applies to prompt-to-video output beyond avatar presenters. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-shot character/scene consistency, scene or environment continuity for prompt-generated footage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
